therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: Single unit umbilical cord blood transplantation
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Myeloablative conditioning followed by cord blood stem cell engraftment
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Reconstitution of hematopoiesis and immune system
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Event Free Survival (EFS) at 1 year post-transplant

results.effect_size: 4 out of 9 research arm participants achieved 1-year EFS
results.target_engagement_evidence: Neutrophil engraftment achieved at mean 17.11 days, platelet engraftment at mean 42.67 days
safety_signals: Acute GVHD in 4/9 research arm patients
Transplant-related morbidity in 8/9 research arm patients
Multiple infections including coagulase negative staph, enterococcus faecalis, E. coli
results.dose_information: Fludarabine 25 mg/m2 daily x3 days, TBI 150 cGy twice daily x4 days (total 12.0 Gy), cyclophosphamide 60mg/kg daily x2 days (total 120mg/kg)

context.comparator: Observational arm with double unit UCBT
